{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "moss_inverted_polarizability_gap_transfer",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "halide_low_polarizability_wide_gap",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "halide"},
          "weight": 0.75,
          "rationale": "Halides showed the most negative source refractive-index effect; by the Moss relation low polarizability implies a wide band gap."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "metalloid_high_index_narrow_gap",
          "conditions": {"dominant_family": "metalloid"},
          "weight": -0.6,
          "rationale": "Largest positive source effect on refractive index; polarizable metalloid semiconductors correspondingly show small optical gaps."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heavy_mean_z_diffuse_valence",
          "conditions": {"mean_atomic_number_bin": "mean_z_high"},
          "weight": -0.45,
          "rationale": "Heavy-Z bin raised source refractive index; diffuse heavy valence orbitals reduce bonding-antibonding splitting and narrow gaps."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "chalcogenide_covalent_narrowing",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "chalcogenide"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Chalcogenides raised source refractive index; shallow chalcogen p valence bands give covalent, comparatively narrow-gap semiconductors."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.2,
      "prior_scale": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.35,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.45,
      "hypothesis": "Source refractive-index effects transfer with reversed sign via the Moss relation: high polarizability implies narrow gap. Fails where source confidences are tiny or where gap and polarizability decouple in mixed ionic-covalent ternaries."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "ionic_closed_shell_wide_gap_prior",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "closed_shell_ionic_halide",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "halide", "transition_metal_flag": "no_transition_metal"},
          "weight": 0.85,
          "rationale": "Ionic halides without partly filled d states have the widest gaps; large electronegativity contrast maximizes valence-conduction separation."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "main_group_oxide_insulator",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "oxide", "transition_metal_flag": "no_transition_metal"},
          "weight": 0.55,
          "rationale": "Main-group oxides are insulators: deep O 2p valence bands and empty cation s conduction states give wide gaps."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "transition_metal_chalcogenide_d_narrowing",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "chalcogenide", "transition_metal_flag": "has_transition_metal"},
          "weight": -0.6,
          "rationale": "Transition-metal sulfides and selenides place low-lying d states above shallow chalcogen p bands, giving small or vanishing gaps."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "metalloid_source_effect_downweighted",
          "conditions": {"dominant_family": "metalloid"},
          "weight": -0.2,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis: the metalloid source effect rests on 30 samples, so its Moss-inverted penalty is strongly downweighted here."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.45,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.25,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 0.9,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "hypothesis": "Ionicity plus absence of partly filled d states, not transferred dielectric magnitudes, drives wide experimental gaps; thin source relations are downweighted. May fail for lanthanide f-state compounds or defect-narrowed halide measurements."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "ionic_closed_shell_wide_gap_prior",
  "lesson": "Source dielectric evidence is low-confidence (0.006-0.37) and only inversely tied to gap, so magnitude transfer is unsafe; ionicity and d-state mechanisms give a sturdier prior, with thin source values downweighted.",
  "revision_summary": "Rewrote both skills with schema-correct field:value condition maps. Kept the Moss-inverted source-grounded transfer but lowered its semantic mass and confidence to reflect weak source support. Sharpened the domain skill by replacing the blanket transition-metal penalty with the mechanistically specific transition-metal chalcogenide interaction, retaining the explicit metalloid counter-hypothesis downweight. Selected the domain-knowledge skill for deployment."
}
